**N04 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:57, Architectural register observer and forwarding. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. Evidence: Both MAINCPU readers populate global maincpu_regs. mos6510.h:116-136 recomposes N/Z and the unused status bit; the fixture P is $A0. D1 covers status combinations, wide clock/PC, exactly-once calls, preserved returns/state and sink failure. Rationale: The two public read seams expose correct resume-boundary registers and the complete load result. They do not provide arbitrary-cycle local register access. Required outcome: Bind these same cases to both real wrappers and preserve the emitted streams.

**N05 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:91, DRIVE payload validation and resource/media consequences. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. Evidence: The pinned writer puts has_tde and has_drives first. Missing modules take the TDE-off read path. drive_resources_type detaches images before changing type; NONE disables the unit, and iecbus.c:493-547 changes routing. D1 validates payloads and D5 records effective type/TDE/media after load using public APIs. Rationale: The launch precondition side effect is explicitly observable rather than silently claiming attached media remains available. Required outcome: Reject invalid/truncated payloads before launch and record detached/no-media context and resumed workload behavior per unit.

**N06 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:79, Provider/helper consumers and managed fakes. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. Evidence: D0 enumerates per-method direct and transitive native consumers, excluding comments/strings and pure managed IViceNative fakes. Its controls include plain Fact native use, helper/provider-only use, fake-only use and string-only mention. Live wide scan has 56 candidate files, not a final semantic method count. Rationale: Neither token hits nor all IViceNative implementations are valid final consumer denominators. Required outcome: Retain the exact method ledger, owner for replacement and managed fake selection; N24 strengthens the successful ordinary-discovery control.

**N07 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:91, Absolute cycle limit and full nonempty window. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. Evidence: initcmdline.c:279-286 stores an absolute limit; main CPU loops test clock > limit after an instruction. D1/D5 now require W CPU cycles and 2W half-cycles after successful load, permit counts, retained overshoot tail and explicit exit reason. Rationale: No exact stopping cycle is inferred from -limitcycles. A short clock/PC prefix or prelude-only result cannot satisfy continuation. Required outcome: Keep truncation, early exit, overflow and prelude-limit negative controls; N23 defines the terminal outcome.

**N08 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, Mock contracts before real artifact dependencies. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: Every D5 Slice 1 family is created mock-bound in D1 under VsfSlice1Contract. D5 adds same-assertion VsfSlice1Real cases using artifacts produced in that run. D2 explicitly selects contracts without requiring future real artifacts. Rationale: This removes the D2-before-D5 dependency deadlock without skips or stale artifacts. N20 now enforces the intended selection split. Required outcome: Retain identical assertions, stable case IDs and both contract/real denominators.

**N09 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:96, Tasks remain pending through the review hold. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: Exit and section 5 keep task 4 pending until step-12 accepted HV, and task 5 pending until Phase E/final managed acceptance. Live TODO tasks 4/5 are false. Rationale: Execution evidence can be attached without claiming requirement satisfaction or unauthorized intermediate done-state. Required outcome: Keep evidence attachment and completion transitions separate.
